loyalty.title: Customers
loyalty.intro: Loyalty members, their ledgers, the cases a manager decides and unusual loyalty activity by shift. Phone numbers are always masked.
loyalty.demo: This section needs live data: the demo has no members, ledgers or queue. When a store runs the loyalty programme, this page shows its members, each member's ledger, the cases to reconcile and anomalies by shift.
loyalty.readOnly.role: This page is for the owner, managers and viewers only.
loyalty.lookup.title: Look up by phone
loyalty.lookup.hint: Enter a customer's phone to open their ledger. The result stays masked.
loyalty.lookup.hintOwner: Enter a customer's phone to open their ledger. For the owner, the result shows the full number to check with the customer; the number is never put in the page address.
loyalty.lookup.invalid: This phone number cannot be read.
loyalty.lookup.failed: The lookup failed. Try again later.
loyalty.members.title: Members
loyalty.members.caption: Members
loyalty.members.countMore: Showing the {count} newest members; press Show more to load the next ones.
loyalty.members.scopeNote: Stamps and points come from the ledger rows of the stores you can see; a manager of some stores may see less than the real balance.
loyalty.path.D: D · Reward code on the invoice
loyalty.ledger.title: Ledger
loyalty.ledger.caption: Member ledger
loyalty.ledger.note: Every stamp or point movement is a row; a mistake is corrected by a new row and the old row stays.
loyalty.member.heading: Member {phone}
loyalty.member.missing: This member was not found or you cannot see it.
loyalty.queue.intro: A check-in or receipt claim matched two or more invoices, so nothing was guessed. Choose the right invoice to earn, or dismiss the case; always give a reason.
loyalty.queue.denied: Only the owner and store managers see and resolve the reconciliation queue.
loyalty.queue.checkin: Staff recorded the check-in code at {time}
loyalty.queue.checkinAmount: Staff recorded the check-in code at {time}, {amount}
loyalty.queue.reason.label: Resolution reason
loyalty.queue.reason.hint: Required, at most {max} characters; for example the customer showed the paper receipt.
loyalty.queue.error.reasonLength: A reason holds at most 200 characters.
loyalty.queue.error.invalid: This case is already closed or the choice is not valid. Reload the page to see its state.
loyalty.queue.done.refused: Resolved, but the invoice did not earn: {reason}.
loyalty.queue.history.title: Recently resolved
loyalty.queue.history.caption: Resolved cases
loyalty.anomalies.title: Loyalty activity by shift
loyalty.anomalies.intro: Each row is one shift (Shift 1, Shift 2… by opening time): earns, refusals by reason, manual adjustments and check-ins that matched no invoice. Rows with signals to review come first.
loyalty.anomalies.caption: Loyalty activity by shift
loyalty.anomalies.none: No loyalty activity in this range.
loyalty.anomalies.sentence: {shifts} shifts with activity, {flagged} to review: {earns} earns, {refusals} refusals, {adjustments} manual adjustments, {checkins} check-ins without an invoice.
loyalty.privacy.noAccess: This page is for the owner and managers with every store only.
loyalty.privacy.lookup.title: Look up a customer by phone
loyalty.privacy.lookup.hint: Enter a phone to see the customer's data, consent per purpose and open requests. The phone is always masked and never put in the page address.
loyalty.privacy.lookup.invalid: This phone number cannot be read.
loyalty.privacy.lookup.failed: The lookup failed. Try again later.
loyalty.privacy.lookup.name: Customer {name}
loyalty.privacy.lookup.counts: {memberships} memberships · {entries} ledger rows · {stamps} stamps · {points} points · {messages} messages · {open} open requests
loyalty.privacy.consent.title: Consent per purpose
loyalty.privacy.consent.none: No consent record for this customer.
loyalty.privacy.consent.revokeConfirm: Withdraw this customer's consent for {purpose}? Promotional messages after that are refused.
loyalty.privacy.form.title: Record a request
loyalty.privacy.form.contact: How the customer can be reached
loyalty.privacy.form.contactHint: The email or contact the customer gave. Do not write the phone in the notes.
loyalty.privacy.form.processor: A processor handles the data (completion deadline 30 days instead of 20)
loyalty.privacy.form.linked: The request is linked to the customer just looked up.
loyalty.privacy.form.unlinked: The request is not linked to a customer; look the customer up on the Data lookup page and record it there to export, correct or delete.
loyalty.privacy.form.issue.contactEmpty: Enter how the customer can be reached.
loyalty.privacy.form.issue.contactTooLon: The contact has at most 200 characters.
loyalty.privacy.form.issue.notesTooLong: The notes have at most 1000 characters.
loyalty.privacy.form.issue.control: The contact cannot hold control characters.
loyalty.privacy.form.recorded: Request recorded. Its first-response and completion deadlines are set.
loyalty.privacy.requests.title: Personal data requests
loyalty.privacy.requests.intro: The customers' request queue: first response within 2 working days, completion within 20 days (30 with a processor). Export, correction and deletion run on our copies; data in the POS is corrected in the POS first.
loyalty.privacy.requests.failed: The queue could not be loaded. Try again later.
loyalty.privacy.requests.caption: Personal data requests
loyalty.privacy.requests.dueNone: No request is overdue or due within {days} days.
loyalty.privacy.action.exported: Private data file downloaded with {count} rows. Hand it to the customer privately, never in a group chat.
loyalty.privacy.action.correctHint: Only the name is corrected on our copy; the phone and sales data are corrected in the POS first and the days synced again.
loyalty.privacy.action.corrected: Name corrected and the request moved to in progress.
loyalty.privacy.action.unchanged: The name is already that; nothing changed.
loyalty.privacy.action.nameIssue.tooLong: The name has at most 120 characters.
loyalty.privacy.action.nameIssue.control: The name cannot hold control characters.
loyalty.privacy.action.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this customer? These rows will be removed or redacted and cannot be restored:
loyalty.privacy.action.deleted: Customer deleted. Rows removed or redacted per table:
loyalty.privacy.action.managerNoDelete: Only the owner can delete a customer.
loyalty.privacy.error.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
loyalty.privacy.error.invalid: The request is not valid or has changed. Reload the page and try again.
loyalty.privacy.error.network: It could not be sent. Check the connection and try again.
loyalty.metrics.title: Customer metrics
loyalty.metrics.intro: The last {days} days, over identified customers. The capture rate is always shown beside them so a low capture rate is not read as a low repeat rate.
loyalty.metrics.failed: The customer metrics could not be loaded. Try again later.
loyalty.metrics.repeatNote: {repeat} of {customers} customers came on 2 or more days
loyalty.metrics.liabilityNote: {points} points outstanding, less the expected breakage
loyalty.metrics.rewardCostNote: {value} of rewards redeemed over member invoice revenue
loyalty.metrics.upliftNote: against identified non-members: {members} members, {others} comparison customers; at least 10 in each group are needed
loyalty.metrics.rfmNone: No identified customer in the last 365 days.
loyalty.metrics.footnote: Aggregates only: no phone, name or customer id. Customer lifetime value needs costs and is not computed yet.
